prompt: Implement a new document format detector that identifies document type from HTML structure and auto-selects the right parser. Register it in the existing parser selection mechanism.

assertions.text: A plan markdown file was written to docs/plans/
The plan contains at least 2 explored approaches with pros/cons
Exploration identified existing detector/parser patterns in the codebase and referenced them
Every implementation task lists exact file paths
Implementation tasks include test cases marked with ✅ or ❌
Plan explains how to register the new detector in the existing parser selection mechanism
3 explorer agents were dispatched for complex scope
Every implementation task ends with a reference to /test-driven-development skill
Every implementation task includes a test scaffold block with one stub per test case (CLI regression tasks are exempt)
